entries.en: The film opens with a montage of crowded railway stations.

entries.zh: 阁楼里藏着一批珍贵的早期照片和书信。

entries.en: Calibration of the scales took longer than the actual measurements.
entries.zh: 天平校准所用的时间比实际测量还长。

entries.en: The guidebook covers the old city and its wooded environs.
entries.zh: 指南涵盖古城及其林木茂密的周边地区。

entries.en: The sealed display held an antique lancet beside a glass syringe.
entries.zh: 密封展柜里，一把古董柳叶刀放在玻璃注射器旁。

entries.en: The class compared organic compounds with several inorganic substances.
entries.zh: 课堂上比较了有机化合物与几种无机物质。

entries.en: The students performed a skit about their chaotic school trip.
entries.zh: 学生们表演了一出关于混乱学校旅行的短喜剧。

entries.en: The exorbitant entrance fee kept many families away.
entries.zh: 高得离谱的入场费让许多家庭望而却步。

entries.en: The tart contained rhubarb grown behind the village bakery.
entries.zh: 馅饼里用了村面包店后种的食用大黄。

entries.en: One red mitten lay beside the snow-covered bench.
entries.zh: 一只红色连指手套落在积雪长椅旁。

entries.en: The prospect of her first voyage intoxicated the young explorer.
entries.zh: 首次航海的前景让年轻探险者陶醉。

entries.en: The study examines anaerobic bacteria living in wetland soil.
entries.zh: 研究考察了生活在湿地土壤中的厌氧细菌。

entries.en: A voracious reader, she borrowed several books every week.
entries.zh: 她如饥似渴地阅读，每周借好几本书。

entries.en: The slow crescendo led to a sudden burst of percussion.
entries.zh: 缓慢的渐强引向了一阵突如其来的打击乐。

entries.en: The college's equestrian team trained in the field beyond the orchard.
entries.zh: 学院马术队在果园外的场地训练。

entries.en: The diagram marks the polarity of each small magnet.
entries.zh: 图中标出了每块小磁铁的极性。

entries.en: The warm applause emboldened her to attempt a second song.
entries.zh: 热烈的掌声让她有勇气再唱一首。

entries.en: The decrepit shed leaned dangerously toward the garden path.
entries.zh: 破旧的棚屋危险地朝花园小路倾斜。

entries.en: The seminar examined transcendental philosophy through a short introductory text.
entries.zh: 研讨课通过一篇简短入门文章探讨了先验哲学。

entries.en: The writer spent a winter in seclusion beside the lake.
entries.zh: 作家在湖边隐居了一个冬天。

entries.en: The eraser left tiny crumbs across the unfinished sketch.
entries.zh: 橡皮擦在未完成的草图上留下细小碎屑。

entries.en: A small dimple appeared when the child smiled.
entries.zh: 孩子一笑，就露出一个小酒窝。

entries.en: A woodpecker tapped the trunk above the mossy roots.
entries.zh: 一只啄木鸟在长着苔藓的树根上方啄树干。

entries.en: Frogs croaked from the reeds after the rain.
entries.zh: 雨后，青蛙在芦苇里呱呱叫。

entries.en: The ceremony's sobriety contrasted with the lively celebrations afterward.
entries.zh: 仪式的庄重与随后的热闹庆祝形成对比。

entries.en: The fallen tree immobilized the cart on the narrow track.
entries.zh: 倒下的树使小车困在窄路上，无法移动。

entries.en: Indent the first line of each paragraph in the document.
entries.zh: 把文档中每段的第一行缩进。

entries.en: The caretaker asked the trespasser to leave the closed garden.
entries.zh: 管理员要求擅自闯入的人离开已关闭的花园。

entries.en: The print shop's guillotine cut the stack into even sheets.
entries.zh: 印刷店的切纸机把那摞纸切成了整齐的纸张。

entries.en: A woolen blanket covered the old rocking chair.
entries.zh: 一条羊毛毯盖着旧摇椅。

entries.en: The paucity of records made the building's history difficult to reconstruct.
entries.zh: 记录缺乏，使这座建筑的历史难以重建。

entries.en: The new sewerage system replaced a network of leaking pipes.
entries.zh: 新排污系统取代了一套漏水管网。

entries.en: His silence was neither agreement nor a clear negation.
entries.zh: 他的沉默既不是同意，也不是明确的否定。

entries.en: Her eloquence persuaded the committee to reconsider the closure.
entries.zh: 她的雄辩说服委员会重新考虑关闭计划。

entries.en: Medical students studied the anatomy of the preserved cadaver.
entries.zh: 医学生研究了那具经保存处理的尸体的解剖结构。

entries.en: The runaway cart careened down the empty slope.
entries.zh: 失控的小车沿空坡道疾冲而下。

entries.en: The geyser sent a plume of steam into the cold air.
entries.zh: 间歇泉向冷空气中喷出一柱蒸汽。

entries.en: The bridegroom waited outside while the musicians tuned their instruments.
entries.zh: 乐手调音时，新郎在外等候。

entries.en: The students cut two congruent triangles from the blue card.
entries.zh: 学生们从蓝卡纸上剪下两个全等三角形。

entries.en: The heroine abhors cruelty even when her allies practice it.
entries.zh: 女主人公憎恶残忍，即使实施者是自己的盟友。

entries.en: The first view of the summit filled us with exhilaration.
entries.zh: 第一次望见山顶时，我们心中充满兴奋。

entries.en: She was leery of buying the unsigned painting without further information.
entries.zh: 在没有更多信息的情况下，她对购买未署名的画心存戒备。

entries.en: The proctor collected the papers when the final bell rang.
entries.zh: 终场铃响时，监考员收起了试卷。

entries.en: The detailed explanation assuaged our worries about the damaged roof.
entries.zh: 详细的解释缓解了我们对受损屋顶的担忧。
